verdict.rationale: Maritime documents an official CLI installable via npm that deploys and manages agents from the terminal. It is explicitly designed for AI-agent operation: --json output on every command, stable exit codes, a self-describing contract, and non-interactive env-var auth. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and a probe confirming the docs page exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Maritime CLI lets you deploy and manage agents from your terminal.
The Maritime CLI is built to be operated by other AI agents, not just humans: machine-readable output on every command, stable exit codes, and a live self-describing contract.
Pass --json on EVERY command. Success: one JSON value on stdout, stderr empty.
Authenticate with an env var, never interactively.
